Name: SAFe Scrum
Segments:
- Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), SAFe Scrum Master (SSM),Professional Scrum Master I (PSM I) or equivalent
- The ideal candidate has strong full-stack engineering skills, thrives on a SAFe scrum team, and is passionate about delivering innovative geospatial tools in support of the mission.
- Certificación SAFe Scrum Master.

Name: ICL
Segments:
- Proven track record of publications in relevant conferences (CVPR, ICML, NeurIPS, ICCV, ICL, etc.)
- Work closely with our Data team and specific datasets that can be used for continued pre-training, RLHF, in-context-learning (ICL), and other applications.
- Hands-on expertise with ASIC design flows, IP integration, and relevant design views (.lib, LEF, ICL, PDL).

Name: CSC
Segments:
- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as security studies, security management, or industry recognised certifications such as Certified Protection Professional (CPP), Certified Security Consultant (CSC) or Physical Security Professional (PSP).
- CND, GISF, SSCP, Security X/ CSAP+, CCSP, Cloud +, CSC, GCLD, GSEC, CISSP-ISSEP, FITSP-D, GCSA
- Familiarity with security frameworks such as the NIST CSF, CIS CSC, and ISO 27001

Name: Vorteil
Segments:
- Überdurchschnittlicher Studienabschluss in Informatik, Naturwissenschaften oder einer vergleichbaren technischen Fachrichtung; eine Promotion im Bereich AI oder Machine Learning ist von Vorteil
- Ein gutes Verständnis von Kommunikationsprotokollen wie CAN-Bus oder ROS/ROS2 ist von Vorteil.
- Kenntnisse in der Fertigungsindustrie sind von Vorteil

Name: EME
Segments:
- Media pipelines: MSE/EME, ExoPlayer or native players, demuxers, Widevine or PlayReady DRM
- Experience with media frameworks and streaming protocols, including HLS and MPEG-DASH, DRM, and media playback on HTML5, iOS, and Android platforms; familiarity with MSE/EME, ExoPlayer, Shaka Player, or Dash.js
- An understanding of Electro Magnetic Effects (EME) to include Electro Magnetic Compatibility (EMC) and Electro Magnetic Interference (EMI)

Name: Golden Gate
Segments:
- Founded in 1853, the California Academy of Sciences is a globally renowned, AZA-accredited non-profit scientific and cultural institution located in the heart of San Francisco’s Golden Gate Park.
- You will complete the entity-agent pipeline, build the evidence adapters behind a single envelope, run the benchmark and golden-gate system on a schedule, build the review and batch tooling the team operates, and carry the agents onto ZoomInfo’s Agentic Platform.
- Construct plasmids using modern molecular biology techniques (e.g: Golden Gate assembly, HiFi assembly, etc.)

Name: SalesOps
Segments:
- Background in SalesOps automation (specifically Quote-to-Cash processes).
- Design, build, and maintain scalable data structures (data marts and star schemas) for SalesOps metrics and performance reporting
- SalesOperations #RevOps #SalesOps #Salesforce #DataAnalytics #GoToMarket #SaaS #Hiring #RevenueOperations

Name: Cloud SME
Segments:
- Serve as the primary Tableau Cloud SME for the organization, including user management, security, performance tuning, and environment configuration.
- Share in new feature design as the cloud SME supporting container/k8s first designs

Name: SDLC Ownership
Segments:
- Full SDLC ownership — from requirements and architecture through code reviews, testing, and deployment.
- Modern SDLC Ownership — Operates and teaches a full-lifecycle model: engineers own design, build, test, deploy, and support for what they ship.
- Full SDLC Ownership: Lead the entire lifecycle of digital banking products, from initial idea and architectural design to release and maintenance.

Name: VLDB
Segments:
- The following publications in VLDB conferences reflect the storage work at Couchbase
- Experience managing and supporting Very Large Databases (VLDB).
- Understanding of dimensional modeling, SCD strategies, data partitioning, and VLDB design principles

Name: ML-integrated
Segments:
- You will work closely with Product, Data Science, Marketplace Quality, DSP Partnerships, Publisher teams, and SRE to build ML-integrated and data-driven monetization systems that improve yield, bid rate, win rate, fill rate, attribution readiness, latency, and reliability across PubMatic’s mobile app ecosystem.
- Drive the AI-first transformation of the safety platform: architecting agentic and ML-integrated workflows with the security, auditability, and reliability that production safety systems require
- Experience with experimentation, feature flags, instrumentation, analytics, and product or quality-of-experience metrics; familiarity with AVFoundation, VideoToolbox, HLS, media playback, recommendation systems, accessibility, or ML-integrated products is a plus.

Name: Anna
Segments:
- This position assists every aspect of the Santa Anna Label Group’s (SALG) A&R department.
- 1 ⃣ Meet our Recruiter Anna — your first conversation is a chance to share your experience and aspirations.
- We produce award-winning scripted and unscripted Original Series, such as “Boyhood”, “Anna”, and “SNL Korea”.

Name: Arista Networks
Segments:
- Arista Networks: EOS, CloudVision (CVP), modern spine-and-leaf designs.
- Experience with or exposure to networking platforms such as Palo Alto Networks, SonicWall, Arista Networks, Extreme Networks, or similar technologies.

Name: latte
Segments:
- Home office setup and coworking allowances. Working from a coffee shop? You can use your coworking allowance for the requisite latte!
- Experience using eMASS / Xacta / SNOW / LATTE ART
- Subsidized meals at our onsite cafe, smoothie bars and coffee bars (aka $5 for a made-to-order salad, sandwich, pizza, or sushi, or $2 for a delicious smoothie or latte)

Name: PyData
Segments:
- We host and sponsor London’s PyData and Machine Learning Meetups
- We actively engage with the technology community by hosting and sponsoring events (PyData, Hackathons, DEV.BG), speaking at industry conferences and open-sourcing technology; see github.com/man-group
- We host and sponsor Boston meetups and London’s PyData and Machine Learning Meetups

Name: nutzen
Segments:
- Innovation als Waffe: Sie nutzen modernste Technologien wie KI zur Log-Analyse und Pattern-Detection, um Angreifern immer einen Schritt voraus zu sein und neue Mitigation-Ideen im Team zu implementieren.
- Kundenprojekte mit echtem gesellschaftlichem Nutzen
- Wir agieren nicht als reine Demo-Abteilung, sondern als vertrauenswürdige Berater, die komplexe Geschäftsanforderungen in messbaren wirtschaftlichen Nutzen übersetzen.

Name: Aon
Segments:
- Operate AON's high temperature industrial 3D printers to the point of becoming an expert
- Conduct thorough job evaluations and market pricing using Aon Radford as the primary survey source, along with other providers (e.g., Mercer, WTW, Culpepper).
- Leaders at companies like Databricks, Aon, HubSpot, and HelloFresh trust GoodTime to orchestrate smarter, faster, people-first hiring experiences for their candidates, interviewers, and talent teams.

Name: GDSA
Segments:
- GIAC (e.g., GSEC, GCED, GCIH, GMON, GCIA, GDSA, etc.)
- Certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, AWS Security Specialty, GIAC (GCSA, GWEB, GDSA).
- GDSA: GIAC Defensible Security Architecture

Name: Kenntnisse
Segments:
- Sehr gute Kenntnisse der regulatorischen Bankenstandards.
- Du hast fortgeschrittene Kenntnisse in Programmiersprachen wie Python, TypeScript, oder Java
- Kenntnisse in der Fertigungsindustrie sind von Vorteil

Name: HAM
Segments:
- ITSM, HAM, SAM and/or CSM experience
- You will serve as the technical SME for Software Asset Management (SAM) and Hardware Asset Management (HAM), ensuring our platform delivers an accurate, real-time view of asset visibility and cloud consumption.
- Expertise in various ServiceNow modules: ITSM, ITOM, ITAM (SAM/HAM), GRC, SecOPS, IRM, CSM;
